jobs.title: Workplace Experience Coordinator
jobs.description_text:
About the Role

Chime is hiring a Workplace Experience Coordinator for our New York City office. You'll own a core set of the day-to-day operations of our recently opened 84,000 sq. ft. space, working closely with our Workplace Experience Lead based in New York City and our Regional Workplace Manager based in Chicago as part of a small, hands-on team.

Our New York City office is still new, which means some processes and playbooks are already in place while others are continuing to evolve. That creates a lot of variety in the day-to-day and a real opportunity to shape how the space operates, how Chimers experience it, and how Workplace scales with the office as it grows.

The details matter. We’re building a great experience for Chimers, and like any good product, that experience often comes down to the small things. We’re looking for someone who sees it that way - someone who understands that a restock, a room reset, or a quick follow-up may seem small on its own, but together – those moments shape the overall experience. Someone who treats the office as something they’re building, not just maintaining; who is curious about how things work, takes ownership of their scope, and raises issues early with enough context for the team to move quickly.

This role is expected to be in the office five days a week.

In this role, you can expect to:

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We’re changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don’t just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

jobs.title: Territory Restaurant Manager
jobs.location_raw: Chicago, IL · Austin, TX · New York, NY
jobs.description_text:
Who we are 

At Picnic, we’re reinventing the way employees experience lunch at work. By partnering with top local restaurants and batching hundreds of orders, we make it easy for companies to offer high-quality, individually packed meals, without fees or tips. Our mission is to create a seamless, affordable, and joyful lunch experience that benefits both employees and employers.

 

About the role

As a Territory Restaurant Manager, you’ll own restaurant supply for the XYZ region: find the right restaurants, sign the partner, and make sure they deliver: enough capacity, prepped on time, packaged properly, with menus and photos worth ordering from. That means real ownership and real accountability from day one. You’ll spend time in facilities and restaurants, tasting food and talking to operators.

 

What you’ll do

  • Selection. Selection depth and cuisine coverage are a key KPI. You decide where it comes from: brick-and-mortar partners, standalone restaurants, and CK facility operators (with CK sales). You make sure every hub has real options at the different price tiers.
  • Restaurant performance. Signing, onboarding, launch, and ongoing health. You own the capacity model, drive on-time prep, and make the pause and unpause calls. If a partner’s prep-by times slip in month three, that’s yours to diagnose and fix.

Garda Capital Partners (Garda) is a multi-billion dollar alternative investment firm with over 22 years of experience deploying relative value strategies across fixed income markets for institutional investors. We hire, grow, and mentor great talent and remain steadfast in our commitment to building a culture that helps them succeed. Garda is more than a workplace. We are built on trust, integrity, and a shared vision for how we work together, the enduring relationships we build, and the consistency of our results. Garda's primary offices are located in Wayzata, New York City, West Palm Beach, Geneva, Zug, Copenhagen, Singapore, and Scottsdale. 

Garda is seeking an experienced, highly capable Senior Executive Assistant to partner with our existing support staff to provide comprehensive support to our Chairman/Chief Executive Officer. This role will be based in our Scottsdale office, where the CEO is based for the majority of the calendar year. This is a high-impact role requiring exceptional judgment, discretion, organization, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly professional environment.

jobs.title: 2027 ARS Research Summer Intern
jobs.description_text:
ARS Investments - Research Summer Intern                          

SUMMARY 

The ten-week internship program in Chicago is designed to provide an introduction to the alternative investment industry. Interns receive real-world experience that will foster professional development while complementing their studies. Internships in the Investments department are geared towards rising seniors pursuing a career in the investment management industry.

The Research department’s primary focus is to identify, underwrite, and monitor investments within alternative investment managers and related opportunities on a global basis using a variety of investment strategies such as credit, equities, macro, quant, relative value, or multi-strategy. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

Freeform is deploying software-defined, autonomous metal 3D printing factories around the world, bringing the scalability of software to physical production. About the Company

General Matter enriches uranium.

We are designing, building, and operating the world’s lowest-cost enrichment services, here in the US.  

In the process, we are restoring America’s ability to produce nuclear fuel to power AI, advanced manufacturing and critical industries our country relies on to remain competitive.
